candidates.description: Local media downloader and library for macOS, Windows and Linux, with a browser extension and an MCP server for AI assistants
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Captae

简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

macOS、Windows、Linux 上的本地媒体下载和管理工具。粘贴一个链接，或者在浏览器里点视频旁边的「下载」，Captae 挑好清晰度、下载、存成好用的文件，放进能搜字幕的素材库；
Claude、Cursor 这些 AI 助手也能通过 MCP 让它下载、找素材、转文字。所有文件、素材和登录状态都只在你自己的电脑上。开源，AGPL-3.0 许可。

![下载页](screenshots/downloads.png)

## 能做什么

- **下载**：YouTube、B 站、X、抖音 / TikTok、Instagram 等网站的视频和音频（网页交给 yt-dlp），M3U8（HLS）流和媒体直链。
  下载前能看每一档清晰度多大；播放列表、多视频帖子、B 站分 P 可以挑着下；正在直播的可以「从现在开始录」，录够了「停止并保存」。
- **要登录的也能下**：在 Captae 自带的登录窗口里登录一次，或者用浏览器插件带上浏览器里的登录状态（见下面「登录」）。
- **说清楚为什么下不了**：要登录、要验证、地区限制、被网络拦截、视频已删除、受 DRM 保护……每种都有对应的说法和下一步按钮，不是一句笼统的「失败」。
- **素材库**：下好的文件自动入库，按标题、标签和字幕里的话搜；转换格式（MP4、WebM、MOV、ProRes、MP3、FLAC……）、精确剪辑、拼接、换音轨、生成和烧录字幕、在访达中显示。
  可以用你自己的 AI 模型（DeepSeek、OpenAI、本地的 Ollama……，自己填密钥）按内容分好类、加标签，分好的类能改名、合并，新下载的自动放进去；发过去的只有标题、简介和来源，看不出内容时附上封面和字幕的开头一段（最多 300 字）。
- **语音转文字**：没有字幕的视频在本机识别成字幕和文字稿（faster-whisper，声音不上传）。
- **发给 AI**：把一个视频整理成文字稿 + 关键画面，放进剪贴板，贴进 AI 对话就能让它理解视频内容。
- **复制了链接也能下**：复制了视频链接、1 分钟内打开 Captae，它在下载页问一句要不要下（复制的那一刻什么都不弹）；Captae 里也能直接粘贴。
- **浏览器插件**：网页里的视频旁边出现下载按钮和清晰度菜单，右下角显示进度；工具栏面板列出这一页能下的视频、声音和图片，最近找到的也会出现在 Captae 的侧栏里。
  YouTube、X、小红书、B 站、TikTok、抖音、Instagram、Facebook 上，「下载」按钮直接放进网站自己的那一排按钮里（点赞、分享旁边），信息流里每条帖子下的就是这条帖子的视频；
  小红书图文和 X 的图片帖能直接下原图；有字幕的视频，菜单里能单独下字幕（SRT）。
- **存网页**：在网页上点右键「把这个网页存下来」，或者插件面板里「存下 › 存成网页」，整个网页存成一个 .html，图片、字体、样式和视频当时的画面都在文件里，断网也能打开；Captae 开着就放进素材库。
- **复刻整站**：右键「复刻整站…」，把网页（可以连同链接到的同站网页，最多 30 页）打开时的每个请求原样录下来放进素材库；以后打开时 Captae 在你的电脑上回放，原网站的脚本照样运行，能点能翻页，断网也行。
- **用 AI 复刻成可改的工程**：电脑上装着 [magpie](https://github.com/yetone/magpie) 时，可以让 magpie 里的模型照复刻下来的网页写一份干净的 HTML / CSS 工程，写好以后和原网页截图对照、差得多就再改（最多 3 轮）。用的是 magpie 里的模型额度。
- **AI 助手**：MCP 服务器提供下载、转换、字幕、剪辑、拼接、查素材库、给素材分类、预设、发给 AI 等工具；你可以整个关掉，或者只开放一部分，每次调用都有记录。
- **多种语言**：界面、提示和命令行支持简体中文、English、繁體中文、日本語、한국어、Deutsch、Español、Français，默认跟随系统，设置里可以换。

| | |
|---|---|
| ![素材库](screenshots/library.jpg) | ![上手引导](screenshots/onboarding.jpg) |
| ![设置：已登录的网站](screenshots/settings.png) | ![AI 助手](screenshots/agent.png) |

## 录直播

- 读到正在直播的链接（含电台流）时，Captae 会说「这是正在进行的直播」，点「从现在开始录」才开始录。录制中在下载页、浏览器插件网页上的卡片、插件工具栏面板里都能点「停止并保存」，
  录到的部分整理成能播放的文件放进素材库；「取消录制」会删掉录到的，要先确认一次。直播自己结束了也会自动保存。
- 录过的直播链接不算「下载过了」：直播频道的链接每次录到的是不同的内容，插件按钮、清晰度菜单、工具栏面板都不会说「下载过了」。
- AI 助手让 Captae 录直播时，默认最多录 10 分钟（它可以说要录多久，最多 180 分钟），录满自动停止并保存；你也可以随时在 Captae 里提前「停止并保存」。
- 命令行：`captae download <链接> --record-live [--max-minutes N]`。不写 `--max-minutes` 就一直录；录制中按一次 Ctrl-C 停止并保存，再按一次直接退出——
  没来得及整理的原始数据会留着，命令行会告诉你在哪，7 天后自动删掉。
- Captae 在录制中途退出了，下次打开时会把录到的部分整理好放进素材库，并提示一次放在哪。

## 连接 AI 助手

在 Captae 的「AI 助手」页：

- **Cla

# adf: a fleet of desktops for AI agents


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2ab670bf-780c-468c-a540-9e14d5c19c3b





Run many lightweight, sandboxed Linux desktops on your own computer, give any agent the tools to
use them over MCP, and watch every one of them live. adf is infrastructure only: desktop
lifecycle, computer-use tools and a console. Bring your own agent.

Each desktop is a [smolvm](https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm) microVM running Xvfb, openbox
and Firefox at 1280x800. Desktops are copies of a running template, so they start in about a
second and share its memory until they change it.

Status: early development. Tested on macOS (Apple silicon) and Linux (KVM).

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CodeGeek04/agent-desktop-fleet/main/install.sh | sh
```

The script installs `adf` to `~/.local/bin` (it checks the published SHA-256) and installs smolvm
if it is missing. Or with Homebrew:

```sh
brew tap CodeGeek04/adf https://github.com/CodeGeek04/agent-desktop-fleet
brew install CodeGeek04/adf/adf
```

Supported: Apple silicon Macs, and Linux on x86_64 or arm64 with KVM (bare metal, or a cloud VM
with nested virtualization). The binaries are not notarized; installs through the script or
Homebrew are not quarantined, but if you download an archive in a browser, clear the quarantine
flag with `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine adf`.

## Quick start

```sh
adf doctor          # checks smolvm and hardware virtualization
adf init            # gets the desktop template ready (downloads a prebuilt image once)
adf create a b      # two running desktops
adf key a ctrl+l && adf type a "example.com" && adf key a Return
adf screenshot a    # writes a.png
adf console         # watch them live in your browser
adf rm a b
```

## Use with your coding agent

adf works with any MCP client. Two pieces make an agent good at it: the **MCP tools** (`adf mcp`)
and the **adf skill**, which teaches the agent to split a task across desktops, stay within your
computer's limits, run desktops in parallel, hand you control for logins or payments, and delete
its desktops afterwards.

**Claude Code: install the plugin** (skill and MCP tools together):

```
/plugin install adf --marketplace CodeGeek04/agent-desktop-fleet
```

Then ask in plain words, for example: "Use adf desktops to compare a long weekend in Seattle, San
Diego or Las Vegas: flights, hotels and things to do." The plugin starts `adf mcp`, so `adf` must

candidates.readme_excerpt: Rig is a Rust library for building applications on large language models. It also ships `rig`, a terminal coding agent built on the library that you extend with Bevy plugins. ## The coding agent ```bash cargo install rig rig ``` This installs the launcher of the latest release. Each release's guide is on its tag, such as [0.47.0's guide](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/blob/v0.47.0/docs/agent.md). The [agent guide](docs/agent.md#install-and-run) on `main` can be ahead of the release, and shows how to install `main` from a checkout. The agent needs Rust 1.97.1 or newer and runs on Linux and macOS. The first `rig` builds the agent, which takes several minutes, and opens it. Run `/login` to sign in or save an API key, or export one such as `OPENAI_API_KEY` before starting. `/model` picks a model and `/help` lists the commands. `rig -p "fix the failing test"` answers one prompt and exits. # Aile Göç Hikâyesi

**Soy ağacınızı verin; Claude atalarınızın yaşadığı her yeri kendi döneminde araştırsın, kaynaklı bir rapor yazsın ve ailenizin göçünü Türkçe seslendirmeli bir harita videosuyla anlatsın.**

`family-migration-story`, [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com) için bir skill ve plugin'dir. Girdi olarak e-Devlet "Alt-Üst Soy Bilgisi" PDF'ini, MyHeritage / Ancestry / FamilySearch'ten alınmış bir GEDCOM dosyasını ya da elle yazılmış bir listeyi kabul eder.

![Örnek videodan: Selanik'ten İzmir'e mübadele yolu](docs/ornek-rota.gif)

<sub>Yukarıdaki görüntüler aşağıdaki uydurma "Örnek ailesi"nden alındı. Kişiler kurgusaldır; yerler, tarihler ve kaynaklar gerçektir.</sub>

## Ne üretir?

1. **Araştırma dosyası** (`research/dossier.json`): Ailenin yaşadığı her yer, ailenin orada bulunduğu yıllar için araştırılır. Kaynaklar arasında Osmanlı arşiv kataloğu, salnameler, nüfus sayımları, Wikidata, akademik makaleler (OpenAlex, Crossref, DergiPark) ve dijitalleştirilmiş kitaplar (Internet Archive, HathiTrust) var. Her bulgu kaynağıyla ve bir güven derecesiyle yazılır.
2. **HTML rapor** (`report.html`), şunları içerir:
   - köken dağılımı
   - kuşak kuşak kişiler
   - her yerin o zamanı ve bugünü
   - aile olaylarıyla dünya olaylarını birleştiren zaman çizelgesi
   - açık sorular
   - kaynakça
3. **Harita videosu** (`video/out/*.mp4`), [Remotion](https://www.remotion.dev) ile hazırlanır:
   - Anne ve baba tarafları ayrı ayrı değil, tek bir zaman çizgisinde iç içe anlatılır.
   - Göç yolları haritada çizilir ve dönem fotoğrafları gösterilir.
   - Savaşlar, antlaşmalar, mübadele ve Soyadı Kanunu gibi dünya ve Türkiye olayları hikâyeye katılır.
   - Seslendirme bilgisayarınızda yapılır; Türkçe için [yazgi-tts](https://huggingface.co/erkamk/yazgi-tts-1) kullanılır.

## Önerilen model: Claude Opus 5.5, effort `xhigh`

Bu skill uzun ve çok adımlı bir iş yapar: onlarca kaynak okur, yüzlerce araç çağrısı yapar, bulguları derecelendirir, sonra hikâyeyi ve videoyu kurup kontrol eder. En iyi sonucu **Claude Opus 5.5** ve **xhigh** effort ile verir. Daha küçük bir model ya da daha düşük effort daha az kaynak okur ve daha yüzeysel bir araştırma çıkarır.

Claude Code'u bu ayarlarla başlatın:

```bash
claude --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort xhigh
```
